values.note: 2027 on the booking site: $48 weeknights, $51 Saturday (every site is the same 20/30-amp class; probed 2027-05-20, 07-13 and Sat 07-17). 2026: $45 (DNR rates table and the booking site for 2026-10-27). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Mears State Park: one fee schedule for all 175 campsites, feeDetails 45 on 2026-10-27, 48 on 2027-05-20 and 2027-07-13, 51 on Sat 2027-07-17; gtc_probe.py) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Mears / East and West Loops: modern 20/30 AMP $45), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (all 175 campsites 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only, Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps, Sewer Hookup=No') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mears (tag 'Electrical service'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Every site has a concrete pad. East Loop 79 sites, West Loop 96. Allowed equipment by site on the booking site: up to 20 ft on 5, 25 ft on 9, 30 ft on 16, 35 ft on 92, 40 ft on 50, 50 ft on 2, and one site 'over 50''.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mears ('Number of sites: 175'; 'All sites have a concrete pad'; tag 'Pull-through sites available') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (maps East Loop and West Loop, allowedEquipment per site), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Two-lane sanitation station with potable water at the campground entrance. The beach-house store (Simple Adventures) sells food, firewood and ice. Free self-pay EV fast chargers in the park.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mears (campground tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Sanitation station', 'WiFi', 'Concession or store'; 'The park's sanitation station is located at the entrance of the campground. There is potable water available and two lanes.'; 'Simple Adventures, located in the beach house, sells food, merchandise, firewood, ice and more'; 'free, self-pay EV fast-charging stations'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mears (Mears Modern Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-25

note: Modern campground in two loops (east and west) on the sandy Lake Michigan shore in Pentwater, a short walk to the swim beach, fishing pier and town; sites are surrounded by sand. The day-use lot can fill on summer afternoons. --Claude
